# Battle of Glendale

## Union Forces

### McCall’s Division — Pennsylvania Reserves

**Brig. Gen. George A. McCall**

**First Brigade — Col. Seneca G. Simmons**

- 1st Pennsylvania Reserves
- 2nd Pennsylvania Reserves
- 5th Pennsylvania Reserves
- 8th Pennsylvania Reserves
- 13th Pennsylvania Reserves

**Second Brigade — Brig. Gen. George G. Meade**

- 3rd Pennsylvania Reserves
- 4th Pennsylvania Reserves
- 7th Pennsylvania Reserves
- 11th Pennsylvania Reserves

**Third Brigade — Brig. Gen. Truman Seymour**

- 6th Pennsylvania Reserves
- 9th Pennsylvania Reserves
- 10th Pennsylvania Reserves
- 12th Pennsylvania Reserves

**Artillery**

- Randol’s Battery — six 12-pounders
- Kerns/Amsden Battery — four 10-pound rifles
- Cooper’s Battery — six 10-pound Parrott rifles
- Diederichs Battery
- Knieriem Battery
  The two latter “German” batteries together fielded eight 20-pound rifles. McCall therefore had five batteries and twenty-four guns across the Whitlock/Sykes position.

### Supporting Union Commands

**Kearny’s Division — Brig. Gen. Philip Kearny**
- Robinson’s Brigade — immediately supports McCall’s right; use the historically appropriate regiments once the detailed OOB is entered.

**Hooker’s Division — Brig. Gen. Joseph Hooker**
- Grover’s Brigade — supports the southern/Willis Church sector; suitable as edge-entry or reinforcement troops.

**Sedgwick’s Division — Brig. Gen. John Sedgwick**
- Burns’s Brigade — begins defending the Nelson field / Willis Church Road sector.
- Dana’s Brigade — returning reinforcement from White Oak Swamp.
- Sully’s Brigade — returning reinforcement from White Oak Swamp.

## Scenario Rules

**Confederate Initiative:** Confederates take the first turn.

**Successive Assaults:** Confederate commands arrive/release in waves rather than beginning completely deployed. Initial testing can use fixed turn releases; refine after playtesting.

**Simmons’s Reserve:** Simmons begins in Reserve. Release when McCall’s front is penetrated, a battery is contacted/captured, or another agreed trigger occurs.

**Sedgwick Reinforcements:** Dana and Sully enter later from the Union rear/eastern edge.

**Whitlock Breastworks:** A short section near Whitlock counts as Defensive terrain. This represents the improvised rail breastworks being constructed by elements of the 12th Pennsylvania Reserves.

**Minor Watercourses:** No game effect.

**Farm Fields and Most Fences:** Decorative unless explicitly classified otherwise.
